vulnerability.name: USN-4957-2
vulnerability.description: USN-4957-1 fixed several vulnerabilities in DjVuLibre. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that DjVuLibre incorrectly handled certain memory  operations. If a user or automated system were tricked into processing a  specially crafted DjVu file, a remote attacker could cause applications  to hang or crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute  arbitrary code.

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in DjVuLibre. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
